Author: Michiru Tsukikage
Name: Crucible SUX
Description:
Crucible SUX (Set-and-forget Unbroken eXecutor) tracks your Beastmaster's Crucible of the Unbroken progress: boards, degrees, Apex and Legendary scores, beasts befriended and their ranks.
It checks whether you can clear the remaining boards in one sitting and suggests a team per board.
Its session queue runs boards through AutoDuty (erdelf's build), watches every run, stops a stuck one and reports back. Its opt-in journey does the Beastmaster job quests, collects the beasts and levels the job to 50, each part off by default. Unattended automation is against the game's terms of service: use it at your own risk.
Punchline: Set-and-forget Unbroken eXecutor: queue the Crucible of the Unbroken boards, step away, come back to a report.
Changelog:
Changed

- BossMod Reborn is now the only mechanics plugin. The original BossMod no longer counts, and a session will not start while it is enabled, because it blocks movement while you cast. Installed but disabled is fine.
